I am running the test suite in `tests/` to verify the fix.
I have resolved the proxy authentication issue in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f48x48z1/requests/utils.py#L960-L987) in [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f48x48z1/requests/utils.py).

### Root Cause
When [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f48x48z1/requests/utils.py#L960-L987) switched from `urlparse` to `urllib3.util.parse_url`, `parsed.netloc` only included the host and port, omitting any `auth` (`username:password`) component from the reconstructed URL. Consequently, [`HTTPAdapter.get_connection`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f48x48z1/requests/adapters.py#L293-L318) stripped proxy credentials before passing the proxy URL to [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_manager_for`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f48x48z1/requests/adapters.py#L167-L202) and [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f48x48z1/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393), resulting in missing `Proxy-Authorization` headers and `407 Proxy Authentication Required` responses.

### Solution
Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f48x48z1/requests/utils.py#L960-L987) to prepend `auth` (when present) back onto `netloc` before calling `urlunparse`.
